title: Quaint Flaky Spanish Shrimp Paella Valenciana
description: A paleo-friendly Spanish dish featuring shrimp, desiccated coconut, and pickle, served on a wooden board, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the desiccated coconut and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped pickle to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to combine with the coconut and pickle mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the shrimp and serve on a wooden board.
